passages.text: Lena wants to play the guitar at the class music afternoon. She decides to practise the same short song for ten minutes after school each day. Her friend Sam listens carefully and helps her with the difficult notes. They do not play all evening, because they also need time for homework and rest. On the day of the music afternoon, Lena feels full of energy and ready to play. She thanks Sam and enjoys sharing the song with the class.

parallelText.en: Lena wants to play the guitar at the class music afternoon.
parallelText.zh: 莉娜想在班级音乐活动下午场弹吉他。

parallelText.en: She decides to practise the same short song for ten minutes after school each day.
parallelText.zh: 她决定每天放学后练习同一首短曲十分钟。

parallelText.en: Her friend Sam listens carefully and helps her with the difficult notes.
parallelText.zh: 她的朋友萨姆认真听，帮助她练习较难的音符。

parallelText.en: They do not play all evening, because they also need time for homework and rest.
parallelText.zh: 他们不会整晚弹琴，因为还需要时间做作业和休息。

parallelText.en: On the day of the music afternoon, Lena feels full of energy and ready to play.
parallelText.zh: 音乐活动那天，莉娜感到充满活力，准备好了弹奏。

parallelText.en: She thanks Sam and enjoys sharing the song with the class.
parallelText.zh: 她向萨姆道谢，高兴地与全班分享这首曲子。

wordHelp.meaning: single musical sounds
happening again at planned times

passages.text: This month, Tao starts junior high school and studies new subjects with new classmates. At first, he worries that his schoolwork will leave no time to help at home. His father suggests making a small plan instead of trying to do everything at once. Now Tao starts his homework after a short rest and helps to do the dishes after dinner. He puts the clean plates on the shelf, then gets his bag ready for the next morning. The plan gives him time for both school life and family jobs.

parallelText.en: This month, Tao starts junior high school and studies new subjects with new classmates.
parallelText.zh: 这个月，涛开始上初中，和新同学一起学习新科目。

parallelText.en: At first, he worries that his schoolwork will leave no time to help at home.
parallelText.zh: 起初，他担心功课会让自己没时间在家帮忙。

parallelText.en: His father suggests making a small plan instead of trying to do everything at once.
parallelText.zh: 父亲建议做一个小计划，而不是想同时做完所有事。

parallelText.en: Now Tao starts his homework after a short rest and helps to do the dishes after dinner.
parallelText.zh: 现在，涛短暂休息后开始做作业，晚饭后帮忙洗碗。

parallelText.en: He puts the clean plates on the shelf, then gets his bag ready for the next morning.
parallelText.zh: 他把干净的盘子放到架子上，然后准备好第二天早上的书包。

parallelText.en: The plan gives him time for both school life and family jobs.
parallelText.zh: 这个计划让他有时间兼顾学校生活与家庭事务。
